_comment: A community on a Symposium Data server. Copy this to community.json, edit it, and run
`/symposium bootstrap --community-file community.json` as a server admin (or root).
community: the community's name, 1-20 letters, digits or underscores. It is unique on
its server, ignoring case; `admin` is a privileged name and not allowed.
admin: the handle of the community's first community admin. Bootstrap writes its invite
file, `<community>-<admin>.invite`; once it joins, it runs the community: it invites
members, assigns access roles and runs the gate.
handles: optional. Members to invite now, each with community-member on every
collection; bootstrap writes one invite file per member, `<community>-<handle>.invite`,
to hand over out of band. The community admin invites more later with `invite`.
data-server-url: the data server the community lives on. One server hosts many
communities, each run by its own community admin.
Names only: nothing secret ever belongs in this file.
